text:
claire: T-minus 12h prelaunch — kicking off a stability dryrun + backout drill. I'll run the checklist, please ack and call blockers now. @ops_oncall @product-lead :hourglass_flowing_sand:
nguyen: Ack. I'll run the canary smoke tests and watch latency graphs.
ash: small nit — which model/version are we pinning for this rollout?
nash: need the exact pin to verify rollback target.
nash: (sorry, name is ash, typo)
claire: Pin is inference-api@v2026-03-18-pin-7 (confirmed w/ release notes).
nash: thanks. I'll prep the quick rollback script and test it in staging.
deploy-bot: deploy initiated by @claire — canary: inference-api:v2026-03-18-pin-7 -> pool=canary-1, replicas=4. ID: db-1763141592.
jordan: Running smoke now — sending 200 req/s for 2m. latency p95 baseline 110ms.
jordan: smoke looks clean so far, no errors, p95 stable.
ops_oncall: Running backout drill in staging: executing rollback command to previous pin to validate process.
ops_oncall: Rollback command used:
```
./deploy rollback --service inference-api --to v2026-03-17-pin-3 --reason "backout-drill" --force-checks
```
ops_oncall: rollback finished in 45s, health checks green. DB migration did not run (expected).
maria: Verified logs: no 5xx spikes during rollback, infra autoscaler behaved as expected.
nguyen: Observed a transient 10% CPU bump right after canary start, resolved within 90s. Put a note in release notes.
claire: Decision: proceed with scheduled change window, canary -> gradual ramp if no customer-facing errors in next 3h. If p95 > 200ms or error rate > 0.5% hold and escalate.
nash: Added runbook snippet to the thread for quick rollback (copy):
```
# fast unpin and rollback
deploy-bot unpin inference-api --pin v2026-03-18-pin-7
deploy-bot rollback inference-api --to v2026-03-17-pin-3\// monitor: /dash/d-slo-latency, /alerts/release-errs
```
claire: Everyone ack to confirm readiness and that you have the rollback playbook open. :white_check_mark:
nguyen: Ack.
nash: Ack, playbook open.
jordan: Ack, monitoring on.
maria: Ack, added note to release notes about the transient CPU bump.
ops_oncall: I'll stay until +2h post ramp to verify stability.
claire: Great — if nothing regresses we'll start traffic shift at T-minus 4h -> gradual ramp. Thanks all. :rocket:
